purpose: Text-free backgrounds for the sticky, rotating weather briefing banner

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready raster background for a very slim sticky weather-news briefing banner in an existing Korean weather web app, not a UI mockup.
Create ONE seamless edge-to-edge wide landscape image, ideally 1920 x 640 (3:1 aspect ratio). The website uses deep midnight navy #0b1630 / #0e131a, pale white text #e9eef5, warm coral #ff8a5c, cool blue #5cb3ff.
Art direction: sophisticated atmospheric editorial landscape illustration, beautifully restrained soft painted gradients, extremely fine matte texture, delicate layers of atmospheric depth. Contemporary, calm, quietly delightful and grown-up; not cartoon clipart, not glossy 3D.
Composition: the LEFT 68% of the entire image must be nearly uniform very dark midnight navy, with only the faintest low-contrast atmospheric tint. This is an intentional blank text-safe region for later HTML copy. Do not put any subjects or bright details there. The transition into the landscape is a completely smooth tonal fade, no visible boundary.
Confine the small weather scene entirely to the RIGHT 30%, with its identifiable subject centered at x=84%, y=50%. Keep important details within the middle 45% of image HEIGHT so they survive a 4:1 or 5:1 banner crop. Landscape fills the edges, no frame or card outline. Keep the bottom and upper margins quiet.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO pseudo-writing, NO typography, NO labels, NO clocks, NO UI, NO buttons, NO borders, NO pagination dots, NO watermarks, NO logos, NO arrows. Do not make a collage or multiple panels. This is ONE background asset. The banner copy and controls will be rendered separately in code.
Theme: tomorrow's sunrise. A very small warm apricot sun just peeking above two distant layered blue mountain ridges on the far right, thin pale gold dawn glow along the horizon, a delicate low cloud wisp. Rich deep blue predawn sky blending invisibly into the dark text-safe left region. Quiet anticipation and a fresh start, subtle warm gold and peach limited to the tiny sunrise scene.
